messages:
sre-oncall: incidentbot shows multiple pages suppressed, customers reporting no SMS pages since 02:13 UTC. anyone else seeing this?

incidentbot: [automated] Alert: paging-suppression triggered for integration 'pager-relay-3' (rule: duplicate-flap). suppressed count: 42. backoff window: 15m. https://internal/redwood/alerts/1705432199

maya: seeing the same. pager logs show 429 from provider around 02:12. i'll tail relay logs: `kubectl logs -l app=pager-relay -c sender -n prod | grep 02:1[2-5] -A3`

alex: pinging provider, also heads-up: oncall handoff in ~10m, need to escalate if unresolved. @liam you oncall next?

liam: i am oncall, joining now. can you paste last 5 lines of the relay error? any customer impact (open tickets)?

maya: log snippet:
```
2026-03-18T02:12:14Z ERROR sender: http 429 from sms-gw - rate_limit
2026-03-18T02:12:15Z WARN retrying in 2s
2026-03-18T02:12:16Z ERROR sender: backoff threshold reached, suppressing page (id=xyz)
```

maya: support thread shows 8 customers reported missed pages in last 20m. CS triaging.

ops-bot: added runbook link: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/paging-backoff. suggested mitigation: enable temporary bypass: `POST /v1/admin/pager-bypass?duration=10m` (requires admin token).

sre-oncall: can we do bypass? what's the blast radius / risks?

liam: ok to enable bypass for 10m, it'll route to alt gateway (alt-sms-2). doing now: `curl -X POST "https://api.internal/v1/admin/pager-bypass" -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -d '{"gateway":"alt-sms-2","duration":"10m"}'` -> response 200

incidentbot: [automated] Action: bypass-enabled by liam for alt-sms-2 until 02:33 UTC. monitoring delivery metrics.

maya: pages flowing again, CS confirms no new misses. still need postmortem on suppression rule (false-positive) + provider SLA followup.

alex: filing incident ticket INC-2026-0318, assigned to eng-pager. include logs and customer list.

sre-oncall: thanks all, i'll stay on until rotation. :thumbsup:
